reading_note: The teaching describes the complete arc of redemption in three discrete states (called "times"): (1) divine truth descends into the natural mind dominated by self-love and is held captive there, fighting and prevailing while its interior goods remain trapped below — until the operative power of regeneration lifts it back to the celestial state; (2) the regenerative order of the spiritual mind is constructed and set in operation, ordering all states until the moment of separation; (3) the call from divine truth manifests its image, choosing out the goods of light, driving falsity downward, awakening Adam (the natural human) by Jesus the Splendour, and continuing until the final extraction (Panaretos) when the cosmos dissolves and what was mingled is fully sifted. The middle state is briefer than the first; the third is greater than the middle but less than the first. The whole is a doctrine of how spiritual time — the duration of states — unfolds from initial captivity through ordering through final purification.
